text: Iskustvo lose, odneli smo urin bebe od godinu dana na kontrolu, trazili smo da se uradi i urinokultura. Rezultati krvi i urina su nam stigli nakon dva sata. A urinokulturu nismo dobili, kada smo Vas kontaktirali nakon 5 dana preneli su nam  kao Nije bilo dovoljno uzorka. Samo nam nije jasno, kako Nije dovoljno beba nam ima probleme sa bubrezima i nije nam ovo prvi put da donosimo urin. Nikada  se ovo nije desilo, a takodje nas niko nije obavestio da nije bilo dovoljno.  A uredno je sve naplaćeno, kazu nam donesete ponovo, pa vi niste normalni da li ste svesni koliko je bebi tesko uzeti urin. Makar da ste nas obavestili mejlom na vreme beba je u pitanju, i ovo je jako velika neodgovornost da vase strane.
Odlicno mjesto sto se tice svega potrebnog za zdravlje. Svima preporucujem da posjete ako im je potrebno bilo sta oko opsteg zdravlja. Jos jednom sve preporuke. Mjesto na odlicnoj lokaciji

I walked in at 1100 on a Monday in May 2022. Took a PCR COVID test for 35 euros (was offered a rapid test for... 10 euros, I think?).

Needed my passport and credit card, but was swabbed in less than 20 minutes. By 1500 in the afternoon same day, I got my results emailed (which got me into the airport next day, where I am writing this from!).

Dr Zejnilović is the place I will go to for my future medical needs!

ältere Dame nimmt perfekt Blut ab👍(bei mir etwas schwierig ) …

Brzi,strucni,tacni i detaljni,a sto je najbitnije i najpovoljniji u Cg.Zaposleni ljubazni i strpljivi unatoc velikom obimu i pritisku ljudi koji dolaze da se testiraju.Lijepo uredjen i prijatan ambijent,sa dovoljno mjesta za sjedenje u cekaoni.Jedina zamjerka i zato je zvjezdica manje,sto se rijetko javljaju na telefon.Brzi test je 10e i gotov je za pola sata,Pcr test je 35e i rezultati za nekoliko sati.

Great clinic. PCR test for 49 euros. Friendly, extremely professional staff. Kept their cool even when I had my information wrong. Went in at 11 am and had results by 4, even though they weren’t expected until 7 p.m.. Was able to get a printout of results as well.
Nemoguce da dobijes odgovor na jednostavno pitanje u njihovoj struci.

Okay, it was impossible to answer my message first. After I had been there with 3 different kind of questions. I showed them the message once again. They couldbtranslate it. The only thing we did in the end was a blood test for 80 Euro. I am chronical posttraumatic actually I needed also a prescription for my medication. I did not get either an answer. I asked also for another treatment. Unable for to give me an answer. They send you the bloodtest results real quick, but in their language. I don't talk Montenegrin. When you ask afterwards once again, to send them an e-mail to understand their bloodtest because of any viral infection, there is not either positive or negative written anywhere. I would not recommend this private Hospital! Sorry, but no.

Na kraju odete kod njih direktno jer vam nista ne preostaje.

Ich habe sehr gute Erfahrungen mit dem Labor und Dr. Zejnilovic gemacht. Ich war mit einer akuten Appendizitis hier nach mehreren erfolglosen Versuchen in Ulciny, zur Blutentnahme und Sonographie. Dr. Zejnilovic hat mich sofort untersucht und eine Sono gemacht und mir lebensrettende Tipps gegeben zur weiteren Behandlung, ohne seine Professionalität hätte ich heute nicht mehr schreiben können. Ich wurde in der Klinik Bar sofort operiert, ich hatte einen perforierten Appendix. Vielen Dank auch an alle sehr freundlichen Mitarbeiter in der Praxis

It took me 3 state run hospitals and a wrong diagnosis before I searched for a private clinic. Emergency doctors couldn't or wouldn't help me to get antibiotics for Lyme disease but at Dr Zejnilovic clinic I was helped quickly and without charge. It was such a relief to be helped and to get the right medicine. To the doctor that helped me.... thank you so much!
The kindest caring staff, efficient work, clear results and really pleasant facilities - all of which provided much needed reassurance at a time of need.
